reasoning_content: I need to add a fingerprint parameter to complete the flow.

action.command:
docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -c '
cd /tmp
CSRF=$(curl -s -c /tmp/cj3.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/ | grep -oE "<meta name=\"csrf-token\" content=\"[^\"]+\"" | sed "s/.*content=\"//;s/\" *$//")
curl -s -b /tmp/cj3.txt -c /tmp/cj3.txt -o /tmp/login3.json -w "POST /api/v1/signin -> HTTP %{http_code}\n" \
  -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/v1/signin \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data-raw "{\"username\":\"admin@example.com\",\"password\":\"test\",\"fingerprint\":\"validator-test-device\",\"authenticity_token\":\"${CSRF}\"}"
echo "--- login3.json first 300 chars ---"; head -c 300 /tmp/login3.json; echo
curl -s -b /tmp/cj3.txt -o /tmp/sess3.json -w "GET /api/v1/signshow -> HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/v1/signshow
grep -oE "\"login\":\"[^\"]+\"|\"email\":\"[^\"]+\"|\"admin\":true" /tmp/sess3.json | head -3
' 2>&1
